question:
A series is given with one term missing. Select the correct alternative from the given ones that will complete the series.

TABQ, VCET, XEHW, ZGKZ, ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic :

 
• First and second letters → (2) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Third and fourth letters → (3) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.

So,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0d06d3711825aa660935c942d62d9172873202ef89932dc678e402b4bd25421.png] 

​Hence, "**BINC**" is the correct answer.
